official.line: Wepsai thangkan khong Global Furry Television
official.domain-heading: Wepsai thangkan khong GFTV long thai duai globalfurry.tv rue gftv.asia
official.domain-body: An thi yu chak thai sut, trong chut sut thai kon khrueang mai thap diao tua raek. Wepsai thi long thai duai yang uen mai chai khong GFTV, mae chue ni cha prakot yu chuang ton khong thi yu ko tam.
official.trusted-link: Rai chue wepsai thangkan khong GFTV thang mot
official.secure-body: Mong ha aikhon mae kunchae rue https:// thi ton thi yu. Chae khomun suan tua chapho bon wepsai thangkan phan kan chueam to thi plotphai thaonan.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) khue chong khao faendom foeri thi yai thi sut nai Esia, mi than yu thi Singkhapo
about.body-2: Rao namsanoe kan toepto khong chao foeri hai thuk khon dai chuenchom thang wan ni lae wan na, lae rao sang phuenthi hai phu khon dai rianru lae khaochai kan lae kan
about.body-3: Thim ngan GFTV krachai tua chak ban koet pai thua thawip yai, pen thim nanachat, lak watthanatham lae lai phasa
